sec-oncall: Security advisory: short-lived investigation into service-account session tokens that bypassed expiry checks after a config change in the IdP. No confirmed compromise, but take immediate steps.
sec-oncall: Required actions for owners of SAML-integrated services: 1) Revoke active federated sessions for svc-* 2) Rotate any long-lived API keys created from those sessions 3) Run `idpctl sessions list --filter 'principal:svc-*'` and revoke.
idp-admin: Confirmed a deployment yesterday toggled `accept_expired_assertions=false` to true accidentally for the `redwood-saml` connector. Rolling back now.
sso-bot: anomaly: 96 keep-alive assertions from 34.120.10.22 between 03:10-03:22 UTC matching pattern svc-*
alice: ack. I'll run an org-wide grep for any references to previously issued cache tokens and check Vault for keys created yesterday.
bob: rotating keys for svc-deploy and svc-ci. New keys stored in Vault under secret/service-keys/rotated-after-idp-incident.
infra: disabled federation issuance and enabled emergency short-lived deploy tokens for critical pipelines.
eng-manager: will prepare a short exec note once containment confirmed. Any customer impact?
sec-oncall: no customer data exposed so far. Audit in progress; forensics assigned if anomalous assume-role activity found.
alice: running audit: `splunk query index=auth "AssumeRoleWithSAML" | stats count by principal, src_ip` and will post findings.
sec-oncall: containment status: IdP rollback applied, sessions revocation in progress, key rotations ongoing. ETA full verification: 2h. Postmortem to follow.
